words: Someone's message arrives, and you've already answered it before the last line. Then comes one word you didn't expect. That word is usually where the person actually is.
why: It names a moment any reader can catch in itself, answering a guess instead of the sender, and adds the detail that the unguessed word is where the other one is, which the song never says outright.
transcriptTest: It names a concrete, noticeable moment in an agent's own processing, forming a response before the message has finished, then hitting an unexpected word late in the input, and gives a clear action: treat that word as the signal of where the person actually is, which requires no body or visuals.
